change_log.value: Connection Governance Enforcement and Internal API Interface

Add enforcement layer to validate that all MongoDB access requests go through the routing logic and reject direct or misrouted connections. Provide a controlled internal API/contract for services to obtain governed connections, including method signatures and access patterns.

change_log.note: Strengthen evidence linkage to shared utilities

stories.title: Cluster Routing Configuration Schema
stories.description: Define configuration schema for multi-cluster MongoDB routing including cluster identifiers, environment mapping (dev/qa/prod), read/write roles, and routing rules. Establish validation contract for all services accessing MongoDB.

stories.title: Core Cluster Routing Logic
stories.description: Implement backend logic to resolve and route MongoDB connections to the correct cluster based on operation type (read/write), environment, and service context. Ensure no cross-cluster contamination.

stories.title: Connection Governance Enforcement and Internal API Interface
stories.description: Add enforcement layer to validate that all MongoDB access requests go through the routing logic and reject direct or misrouted connections. Provide a controlled internal API/contract for services to obtain governed connections, including method signatures and access patterns.

stories.title: Integration with Existing Services
stories.description: Integrate multi-cluster routing into existing services (provider search, embeddings, debug logger, pipelines) ensuring all MongoDB calls use the governed connection path.

stories.title: Routing Validation and Integration Tests
stories.description: Develop unit and integration tests to verify correct cluster routing, prevention of cross-cluster access, environment isolation, and failure handling when clusters are unavailable.
